issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares messageOnFeed() as public (UML shows '+ messageOnFeed(): String'), but the solution implements it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed() in Animal.java). This visibility mismatch between the specification and the provided solution may confuse students about the intended visibility of the abstract method and what signature they should implement/override.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent with the UML/specification. Either change the abstract method in Animal.java to public (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) to match the UML, or update the UML and problem text to explicitly state that messageOnFeed() is protected. Preferably declare the method as public in Animal so students implementing the class follow the UML signature.
